summary.text: Shelly Simonds is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 70th District since 2020.
The district covers part of the City of Newport News.
The House profile lists Shelly Simonds as vice chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Shelly Simonds was born in Oxford, OH.
The profile lists a B.A. from Bucknell University (1991) and an M.A. from Stanford University (1994).
Shelly Simonds's listed occupation is family property manager.
The profile lists Sister Cities of Newport News (vice chairman), the Womens Club of Hilton Village, Hilton Presbyterian Church and the Virginia Sierra Club.
Shelly Simonds serves on the Education Committee (as vice chair), Counties, Cities and Towns, Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, and Appropriations.
